dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Nam, you look upset. What's wrong?
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, juː ˈlʊk ʌpˈsɛt. ˈwʌts ˈrɔːŋ?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I saw an accident this morning.
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈsɔː ən ˈæksɪdənt ðɪs ˈmɔːrnɪŋ.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Near the station. It was raining, and the road was very slippery.
dialogue.reading: ˈnɪr ðə ˈsteɪʃən. ɪt wʌz ˈreɪnɪŋ, ənd ðə ˈroʊd wʌz ˈvɛri ˈslɪpəri.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: A man was riding a motorcycle, and he was going too fast.
dialogue.reading: ə ˈmæn wʌz ˈraɪdɪŋ ə ˈmoʊtərsaɪkəl, ənd hiː wʌz ˈɡoʊɪŋ ˈtuː ˈfæst.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes. He fell off his motorcycle, and it crashed into a car.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs. hiː ˈfɛl ˈɔːf hɪz ˈmoʊtərsaɪkəl, ənd ɪt ˈkræʃt ɪntə ə ˈkɑːr.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: That's terrible! Was he wearing a helmet?
dialogue.reading: ðæts ˈtɛrəbəl! wʌz hiː ˈwɛrɪŋ ə ˈhɛlmɪt?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Luckily, he was. When I left, a lot of people were helping him.
dialogue.reading: ˈlʌkəli, hiː ˈwʌz. wɛn aɪ ˈlɛft, ə ˈlɑːt əv ˈpiːpəl wɜːr ˈhɛlpɪŋ hɪm.
